crossRefs.note: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.
They answered him, “Our father is Abraham.” Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works…
For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;
but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit not in the letter; whose…
But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel that are of Israel.
For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the…
Blessed is the man to whom Yahweh doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,
who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”
In their mouth was found no lie, for they are blameless.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Nathanael
people.line: Disciple of Jesus, from Cana in Galilee.

translations.web: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”
translations.bsb: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, He said of him, “Here is a true Israelite, in whom there is no deceit.”
translations.kjv: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!
translations.asv: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!
